name: BBQ Pork Skewers with Cauliflower-Carrot Mash & Kale Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 8-12 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium head cauliflower
4 medium carrots
1 bunch kale

instructions.primary_message: Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Cut into small, bite-sized florets and transfer to a medium saucepan.

Peel, trim, and thinly slice carrots. Add to the pan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until veggies can be easily pierced with a fork, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, place ketchup, Worcestershire, sugar, vinegar, Dijon, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the BBQ sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup ketchup
4 tsp Worcestershire sauce
2 tsp brown sugar
2 tsp apple cider vinegar
2 tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board; cut into 1-inch pieces. Thread pork onto skewers and place on a large plate; alternatively, you can cook the pork pieces directly on the grill without using skewers.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pour half the BBQ sauce over the skewers and turn to coat. Reserve remaining sauce for serving.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add skewers and grill, rotating every 2½-3 minutes, until browned and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
When the cauliflower and carrots are done, drain in a colander.
Working in batches to best fit your blender, transfer cauliflower, carrots, milk, oil, and spices to the blender; purée until smooth. Cover and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
118 ml (½ cup) whole milk
2 tbsp virgin coconut oil
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a large bowl. Add oil and mash with the back of a spoon until soft and combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
4 tsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Add vinegar, Dijon, sugar, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp apple cider vinegar
2 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp brown sugar
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Finely chop leaves and transfer to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pork skewers, cauliflower-carrot mash, and kale salad between plates. Top skewers with reserved BBQ sauce and enjoy!
